⟪1.⟫ ⟪to fill up⟫, ⟪make full⟫ (in π. of completing contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.): τόπον, ⟪take one's place⟫ (cf. Heb. ⁨מָקוֹם⁩ ⁨מִלֵּא⁩), ⟦1 Corinthians 14:16|I Co 14:16⟧; άμαρτίας, ⟪complete the number⟫, ⟦1 Thessalonians 2:16|I Th 2:16⟧; τ. νόμον, ⟪observe perfectly⟫, ⟦Galatians 6:2|Ga 6:2⟧; pass., προφητεία, ⟪fulfilled⟫, ⟦Matthew 13:14|Mt 13:14⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to supply⟫: τὸ ὑστέρημα, ⟦1 Corinthians 16:17|I Co 16:17⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:30|Phl 2:30⟧ (Cremer, 838).†
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G379.b:

(< ἀπολογεόμαι), ⟪without excuse⟫, ⟪inexcusable⟫ (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; v. Lft., Notes, 252): ⟦Romans 1:20|Ro 1:20⟧ ⟦Romans 2:1|2:1⟧.†
a: Commentaries on St. Paul's Epistles to the Galatians (1892); Philippians (Third Edition, 1873); and Colossians and Philemon (1892), by J. B. Lightfoot. Macmilian. Also Apostolic Fathers, by the same. 5 vols. Macmilian, 1890
Notes on Epistles of St. Paul, by J. B. Lightfoot. Macmilian, 1895

G380.b:
⟪ἀνα-πτύσσω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨פּרשׂ⁩, etc.;] ⟪to unroll⟫: τ. βιβλίον, ⟦Luke 4:17|Lk 4:17⟧ (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G381.b:
⟪ἀν-άπτω⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨יצת⁩;] ⟪to kindle⟫: ⟦Luke 12:49|Lk 12:49⟧, ⟦James 3:5|Ja 3:5⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G383.b:
** ⟪ἀνα-σείω⟫,
[in Aq.: ⟦1 Samuel 26:19|I Ki 26:19⟧, ⟦Job 2:3|Jb 2:3⟧; Aq., Sm.: ⟦Isaiah 36:18|Is 36:18⟧*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to shake out⟫, ⟪shake back⟫, ⟪move to and fro⟫ (Thuc., al.).
⟪2.⟫ In late writers (Diod., al.; v. MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟪to stir up⟫; metaph., ⟪to excite⟫: τ. ὄχλον, ⟦Mark 15:11|Mk 15:11⟧; τ. λαόν, ⟦Luke 23:5|Lk 23:5⟧.†

G384.b:
* ⟪ἀνα-σκευάζω⟫
(< σκεῦος, a vessel), prop. ⟪to pack up baggage⟫, hence, ⟪to dismantle⟫, ⟪ravage⟫, ⟪destroy⟫; metaph., ⟪to unsettle⟫, ⟪subvert⟫ (MM, VGT, s.v.): ψυχάς, ⟦Acts 15:24|Ac 15:24⟧.†

G385.b:
⟪ἀνα-σπάω⟫, -ῶ,
[in LXX for ⁨לקח⁩, ⁨עלה⁩ hi.;] ⟪to draw up⟫: ⟦Luke 14:5|Lk 14:5⟧, ⟦Acts 11:10|Ac 11:10⟧ (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G388.b:

a: Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. John, by B. F. Westcott, 2 Vols., Murray, 1908; the Epistle to the Ephesians, Macmiilan, 1906; the Epistles of St. John, Third Edition, Macmillan, 1892

G389.b:
⟪ἀνα-στενάζω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Lamentations 1:4|La 1:4⟧ (⁨אנח⁩ ni.), Si 25:18 (17), Da TH Sus 22, II Mac 6:30*;] ⟪to sigh deeply⟫: ⟦Mark 8:12|Mk 8:12⟧.†

G390.b:

[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁוּב⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to overturn⟫: ⟦John 2:15|Jo 2:15⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to turn back⟫, ⟪return⟫: ⟦Acts 5:22|Ac 5:22⟧ ⟦Acts 15:16|15:16⟧.
⟪3.⟫ ⟪to turn hither and thither⟫; pass., ⟪to turn oneself about⟫, ⟪sojourn⟫, ⟪dwell⟫: ⟦Matthew 17:22|Mt 17:22⟧ Rec.; metaph. (like Heb. ⁨הלךְ⁩, in κοινή writers and in π.; v. Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟪to conduct oneself⟫, ⟪behave⟫, ⟪live⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 1:12|II Co 1:12⟧, ⟦Ephesians 2:3|Eph 2:3⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 3:15|I Ti 3:15⟧, ⟦Hebrews 10:33|He 10:33⟧ ⟦Hebrews 13:18|13:18⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:17|I Pe 1:17⟧, ⟦2 Peter 2:18|II Pe 2:18⟧.†

G391.b:
** ⟪ἀνα-στροφή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ,

⟪1.⟫ ⟪a turning down⟫ or ⟪back⟫, ⟪a wheeling about⟫ (Soph., Thuc., al.).
⟪2.⟫ In late writers (Polyb., al.; v.s. ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on ⟦James 3:13|Ja 3:13⟧; MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟪manner of life⟫, ⟪behaviour⟫, ⟪conduct⟫: ⟦Galatians 1:13|Ga 1:13⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:22|Eph 4:22⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 4:12|I Ti 4:12⟧, ⟦Hebrews 13:7|He 13:7⟧, ⟦James 3:13|Ja 3:13⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:15|I Pe 1:15⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:18|18⟧ ⟦1 Peter 2:12|2:12⟧ ⟦1 Peter 3:1|3:1⟧, ⟦1 Peter 3:2|2⟧, ⟦1 Peter 3:16|16⟧, ⟦2 Peter 2:7|II Pe 2:7⟧ ⟦2 Peter 3:11|3:11⟧.†

G392.b:
† ⟪ἀνα-τάσσομαι⟫,
[in LXX only as v.l. (Ald.) in ⟦Ecclesiastes 2:20|Ec 2:20⟧;] ⟪to arrange in order⟫, ⟪bring together from memory⟫ (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦Luke 1:1|Lk 1:1⟧.†

G393.b:
⟪ἀνα-τέλλω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨צמח⁩, ⁨פּרח⁩, ⁨זרח⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ trans., ⟪to cause to rise⟫: ⟦Matthew 5:45|Mt 5:45⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Intrans., ⟪to rise⟫: φῶς, ⟦Matthew 4:16|Mt 4:16⟧ (= ⟦Isaiah 9:1|Is 9:1⟧); ὁ ἥλιος, ⟦Matthew 13:6|Mt 13:6⟧, ⟦Mark 4:6|Mk 4:6⟧ ⟦Mark 16:2|16:2⟧, ⟦James 1:11|Ja 1:11⟧; νεφέλη, ⟦Luke 12:54|Lk 12:54⟧; φωσφόρος, ⟦2 Peter 1:19|II Pe 1:19⟧; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaph. of sun or star, ⟦Hebrews 7:14|He 7:14⟧ (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†

G394.b:
⟪ἀνα-τίθημι⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨חרם⁩ (Cremer, 546);] ⟪to lay upon⟫, ⟪set up⟫, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; v. also MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟪to set forth⟫, ⟪declare⟫: ⟦Acts 25:14|Ac 25:14⟧, ⟦Galatians 2:2|Ga 2:2⟧.†

G395.b:

⟪1.⟫ ⟪a rising⟫: of light, ⟦Luke 1:78|Lk 1:78⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪the sun-rising⟫, ⟪the east⟫ (MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦Matthew 2:2|Mt 2:2⟧, ⟦Matthew 2:9|9⟧, ⟦Revelation 21:13|Re 21:13⟧; ἀ. ἡλίου, ⟦Revelation 7:2|Re 7:2⟧ ⟦Revelation 16:12|16:12⟧ (WΗ, pl.); pl., ⟦Matthew 2:1|Mt 2:1⟧ ⟦Matthew 8:11|8:11⟧ ⟦Matthew 24:27|24:27⟧, ⟦Luke 13:29|Lk 13:29⟧.†

G396.b:
⟪ἀνα-τρέπω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨דּחה⁩, ⁨הדף⁩, etc.;] ⟪to overturn⟫, ⟪destroy⟫: ⟦John 2:15|Jo 2:15⟧ WH, txt.; metaph., ⟪to subvert⟫ (MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦2 Timothy 2:18|II Ti 2:18⟧, ⟦Titus 1:11|Tit 1:11⟧.†

G398.b:

[in LXX for ⁨צדק⁩ hi., ⁨גּלשׁ⁩;] ⟪to bring to light⟫, ⟪make to appear⟫: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. ⟪having sighted⟫ C.: ⟦Acts 21:3|Ac 21:3⟧ WH; pass., ⟪to appear⟫, ⟪be made manifest⟫: ⟦Luke 19:11|Lk 19:11⟧.

[in LXX chiefly for ⁨עלה⁩ hi., also for ⁨קטר⁩ hi., etc.;]
